messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to the result of edit 3 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a reflective tiled surface, initially looking down, then raises her right hand to touch her hat and face before lowering it and turning slightly.","camera":"The camera is static, positioned at a high angle looking down at the subject from the front-left.","clothing":"She wears a black sleeveless crop top, light blue baggy jeans, and black slide sandals.","hair_color":"Her hair appears dark, mostly hidden under a bright blue bucket hat.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a low ponytail, with a pink scrunchie visible at the nape of her neck.","identity":"A slim young woman with a fair complexion, shown in a 3D-rendered style.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor or semi-outdoor area with a mix of reflective square tiles and rough, textured concrete ground, illuminated by warm, low-angle sunlight that casts long shadows."},"uncertain":["hair_color"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a sandy outdoor area to the reference tiled/textured concrete environment with warm low-angle sunlight. The character's action and high-angle static framing remain similar, but her top changed from a brown patterned crop top to a black sleeveless crop top, and her hair color appears darker under the blue bucket hat.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference setting while keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserving camera framing/movement and adapting lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the hair color change is due to lighting adaptation or an unintended identity change
unexpected_changes: Clothing changed from a brown patterned crop top to a black sleeveless crop top
Hair color appears darker in the output than in the source
